resources.string: A Skill is reviewed workflow text, not executable code. Saving does not enable it. Only selected and applied Skills accompany your next request. Required tools need separate configuration and authorization.
No Skills yet. Create one or import a UTF-8 Markdown document up to 16 KiB.
These tools are unavailable in this context: %1$s. This Skill cannot be selected yet.
Cannot import. Only bounded UTF-8 text is accepted. Metadata supports name, description and an allowed-tools array; other fields, multiline metadata and script bundles are unsupported.
Leaving clears the unsent draft and current context selection. Saved chats, roles and memory remain.
